articles.title: 'Top Gear' Sets 2028 Return — With Gordon Ramsay as Host
articles.summary: The beloved motor show has been off air since co-host Andrew Flintoff was involved in a serious, on-set car crash in 2022.
articles.content:
If you can't stand the heat … get behind the wheel?

Top Gear is set to return to the BBC with entrepreneur, chef and self-proclaimed car fanatic Gordon Ramsay as its host.

The U.K.'s beloved, long-running series has been off air since 2022 after co-host Andrew Flintoff was involved in an on-set car crash. He suffered serious facial and rib injuries when his open-top vehicle overturned on Top Gear 's test track.

On Wednesday, the broadcaster confirmed that the world's most celebrated motoring entertainment show (previously helmed by Jeremy Clarkson, James May and Richard Hammond) will be back on our screens in 2028. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-article-mid-article-uid0' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid-article1","mid-articleX","mid","mid-article"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article") .addSize([[300,250],[2,2],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4],[300,251]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; }); Related Stories Movies How 'The Other Bennet Sister' Defied the Odds as a Smash Hit Lifestyle "Sometimes You Just Have to Think: 'What Will Make People Laugh?'": Lolly Adefope on Gags, 'Ghosts' and Her West End Debut

Produced by BBC Studios , the all-new series will see Ramsay take the steering wheel, "setting the agenda and leading an all-new lineup of co-presenters through epic adventures, daring tests and spectacular stunts in pursuit of the stories, machines and mayhem that generations of viewers have come to expect and love from the show."

Filming will take place across the U.K. and around the world in 2027, with the iconic Top Gear Test Track at Dunsfold Aerodrome in Surrey once again serving as the show's home and base. Top Gear ’s tame racing driver, The Stig, will also be returning to support the new series in the usual understated way.

Ramsay is no stranger to the show, having been a guest previously on three occasions: in the show’s first series in 2002, its eighth series in 2006 and its 23rd series in 2017. Each appearance saw him showcase his driving skills with a lap of the track — his fastest time clocking in at a blistering one minute and 46.3 seconds behind the wheel of a Chevrolet Lacetti — earning him 7th place on Top Gear’s ‘Star In A Reasonably Priced Car’ leaderboard. blogherads.adq.push(function () { blogherads .defineSlot( 'medrec', 'gpt-dsk-tab-mid-article2-uid1' ) .setTargeting( 'pos', ["mid","mid-article2","mid-articleX"] ) .setTargeting( 'viewable', 'yes' ) .setSubAdUnitPath("ros\/mid-article2") .addSize([[300,250],[300,251],[620,350],[2,4],[4,2],[320,480],[620,366],[300,450],[4,4]]) .setClsOptimization("minsize") ; });

"My love affair with cars began as a child, growing up a field away from Silverstone, where I would climb over the fences and sneak in for a glimpse of the racing," began Ramsay. "That early excitement sparked a lifelong passion for cars, motor sport, beautiful design and extraordinary engineering. At its very best Top Gear has always been about the unexpected — surprising, entertaining and just the right amount of chaos. That’s the spirit we want to build on, bringing a fresh energy and ambition to create something truly thrilling for a whole new generation of audiences. It’s an incredibly exciting opportunity, and I genuinely can’t wait to get started!”

articles.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google A cool new horror thriller is set to make its anime debut with Netflix later this week, and has dropped its official opening theme sequence early to help celebrate its premiere. This series might be missing out on the horror holiday season, but thankfully it's helping to boost up the final stretch of the Fall 2026 anime schedule . Fool Night is a new anime adaptation of Kasumi Yasuda’s original manga, and it's going to be taken on with two of the biggest anime studios around.

Fool Night is a post-apocalyptic series set in a world where there is such a lack of oxygen , people end up planting seeds within their body to keep the little flow of it there is left. It's likely going to be a solid thriller to cap off the year with, and thankfully it won't be too much longer before we see it in action. Fool Night has released its creditless opening theme titled "Shake! spit out" as performed by Tempalay ahead of the anime's debut, and you can check it out below.

Fool Night will be making its worldwide debut with Netflix on November 26th, and will be running for 12 episodes. All of those episodes will be available to watch at the time of release, and the ending theme for the series titled "Iki" as performed by Nowlu. It's going to be a pretty big project too as it's a joint collaboration between two of the biggest anime studios, Sunrise (which has overseen franchises like Mobile Suit Gundam ) and Shaft (known for releases like Puella Magi Madoka Magica ).

Atsuyuki Yukawa is directing the new Fool Night anime for Sunrise and Shaft with Ryo Shimura serving as assistant director, Jin Tanaka handling the series composition, Robert Sato providing the character designs, and Tatsuya Kato composing the music. The voice cast for the anime includes Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya, Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai, Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka, Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno, Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi, Shion Wakayama as Sumi Matsuno, Hiroshi Tsuchida as Ken Hikasa, Nobuhiko Okamoto as Nishi, Sayaka Senbongi as Meg Okumura, and Yumiko Kobayashi as Ivy.

Fool Night will also be debuting with an English dub release when it makes its way to Netflix , and it's going to be spearheaded by the likes of Adam McArthur as Toshiro and Olivia Liang as Yomiko but the majority of the cast has yet to be confirmed as of this time. The series is a darker post-apocalyptic tale with an interesting take on the world as the anime introduces an idea known as "Transfloration," where those dying plant seeds in their bodies to produce more oxygen.

It's been a weaker year for horror anime in general despite some standout releases, but this could end up bridging the gap thanks to its science fiction appeal. With it debuting on Netflix this week, it won't be too much longer before we see what it has to offer. How are you feeling about the new Fool Night anime so far? Top Gear became a global phenomenon in the hands of Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond, James May and producer Andy Wilman. It enjoyed a second life when Chris Harris, Paddy McGuinness and Flintoff took over hosting duties from Matt LeBlanc and Chris Evans.
